rules.name: debt_synced
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("withdraw") or called("harvest")) and post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") != (post("userInfo", sender, "amount") * post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000
rules.why: rewardDebt checkpointed to the final amount

rules.name: debt_le_accrued
rules.expr: ok and post("userInfo", u, "rewardDebt") * 1000000000000 > post("userInfo", u, "amount") * post("accRewardPerShare")
rules.why: no user's debt exceeds accrued (pending never negative)

rules.name: harvest_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("harvest") and sender != A0 and post("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", sender) + pre("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") > pre("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", sender) + (pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") * post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000

rules.name: deposit_pays_pending_only
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("withdraw")) and sender != A0 and post("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", sender) + pre("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") > pre("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", sender) + (pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") * post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000
rules.why: deposit/withdraw pay at most pending on the old amount

rules.name: emission_bound
rules.why: total emitted never exceeds rate times elapsed

rules.name: acc_step
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalStaked") > 0 and wide(post("accRewardPerShare") - pre("accRewardPerShare")) * pre("totalStaked") > wide(now - pre("lastRewardTime")) * pre("rewardPerSecond") * 1000000000000

rules.name: deposit_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and (post("userInfo", sender, "amount") != pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") + arg(0) or post("totalStaked") != pre("totalStaked") + arg(0) or post("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0))

rules.name: withdraw_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and (post("userInfo", sender, "amount") + arg(0) != pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") or post("totalStaked") + arg(0) != pre("totalStaked") or post("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", sender) + arg(0))

rules.name: emergency_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("emergencyWithdraw") and (post("userInfo", sender, "amount") != 0 or post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") != 0 or post("totalStaked") + pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") != pre("totalStaked") or post("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", sender) + pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") or post("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", A0))
rules.why: emergency returns full stake, no rewards

rules.name: harvest_no_stake
rules.expr: ok and called("harvest") and (post("userInfo", u, "amount") != pre("userInfo", u, "amount") or post("totalStaked") != pre("totalStaked"))

rules.name: updatepool_no_pay
rules.expr: ok and (called("updatePool") or called("setRewardPerSecond")) and (post("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: others_amount
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and (post("userInfo", u, "amount") != pre("userInfo", u, "amount") or post("userInfo", u, "rewardDebt") != pre("userInfo", u, "rewardDebt"))

rules.name: reward_to_caller
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", u) != pre("TokenC10_FRM.balanceOf", u) and not called("TokenC10_FRM.transfer") and not called("TokenC10_FRM.transferFrom")

rules.name: lp_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("withdraw") or called("harvest") or called("emergencyWithdraw") or called("updatePool")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC10_LP.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: farm calls never take others' LP

params.condition: arg(0) <= pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") and sender != A0
